reached_sql:
WITH store_sales_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_sold_time_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN (
        SELECT t_time_sk
        FROM time_dim
        WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
    ) AS time_dim_filtered
      ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim_filtered.t_time_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT hd_demo_sk
        FROM household_demographics
        WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
    ) AS household_demographics_filtered
      ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics_filtered.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_sales_filtered
JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_store_name = 'ese'
) AS store_filtered
  ON store_sales_filtered.ss_store_sk = store_filtered.s_store_sk
ORDER BY count(*)
LIMIT 100
